angle.description: The original human take that makes this video ours.

task.description: The painful task being automated (data-entry, invoicing, scheduling, emailing, lookups...).

tool.description: Primary tool shown (Sheets, Excel, Outlook, Notion, Claude...).

lane.description: Content lane / series. Drives the variety soft-cap (no >2 of the same lane in a row).

value_type.description: Which audience-value type(s) this video delivers (the idea-pass Audience Value Test). >=1 required to clear the value gate.

takeaway.description: The ONE reusable thing a viewer can apply or believe differently tomorrow. Defined at the idea-pass; the script-pass checks it was delivered.

approved_tools.description: Paid SaaS product names the OWNER pre-approved to name on screen for this video (paid promo or personal endorsement). Anything not listed is blocked by the QA denylist.

bridge.description: Short → Long ecosystem inputs: which long video a Short drives discovery to + the copy-paste resource surfaced in the pin/description. Consumed by build-metadata.buildBridge (the deliberate Short→Long→pin→template→cross-post chain).

related_long_id.description: content id of the long video this video bridges to (the parent long for a nested Short; a topically-aligned long for a STANDALONE Short — e.g. an inbox Short → the n8n inbox-triage long).

related_long_title.description: Human title of the related long (used in the caption/checklist while its real URL is still <LONG_URL>).

template_link.description: Copy-paste template / resource URL (e.g. an n8n workflow) surfaced in the description AND the pinned comment.

value_score.description: Idea-pass content-value score (0-10). >=9 auto-qualify, 7.5-9 owner decides, <7.5 reject.

value_band.description: Idea-pass gate decision derived from value_score + hard gates.
